concerns.text: Task T012 restricts data ingestion to 'NREL Perovskite Stability Database' and outputs 'nrel_perovskites.csv', silently dropping the FR-001 requirement to fetch data from 'Materials Project and NREL'. This is a semantic weakening of the functional requirement.

Task T029 mandates implementing 'both' Bonferroni and Benjamini-Hochberg corrections. FR-007 requires 'e.g., Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg' (implying one is sufficient). Mandating both is an unapproved scope expansion that violates the computational-budget discipline (Constitution VI) without spec authorization.

Task T030 implements a 'family-based proxy' fallback if external literature data is unavailable. FR-006 and the Spec's Assumptions require 'held-out experimental data from the literature'. A proxy split of the same data is not external validation and violates the core intent of FR-006.

Task T044 requires applying uncertainty weights (1/σ²) to Random Forest and Gradient Boosting. The Spec's Assumptions only explicitly authorize weighting for Elastic Net or when metadata is provided. Standard scikit-learn RF/GB do not natively support this weighting mathematically; this task implies unverified custom implementation not authorized by the spec.

Task T006 specifies 'multiple retries with exponential backoff' but omits the spec's strict constraint of 'up to 3 times' and the specific interval sequence '(min, min, 4 min)'. This semantic relaxation of the error-handling constraint violates the Edge Cases specification.
